blocking.section: M3 AI gateway, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket and SSE; M4 Event protocols, multi-region and benchmark suite; Sequencing
blocking.issue: Two milestone exits depend on community adoption, which the project does not control, and both numbers are tagged (hypothesis). Because milestones must exit in order, a shortfall of outside contributors or public adopters would block M4 and M5 engineering indefinitely. The vision document defines SM-14 and SM-15 as success metrics, not as release gates.
blocking.evidence: M3: "At least 50 external contributors have merged DCO-signed commits (hypothesis), per SM-14." M4: "At least 25 production adopters reference Ruralz publicly (hypothesis), per SM-15." Sequencing: "Milestones exit in order."
blocking.fix: Move SM-14 and SM-15 out of the numbered Exit criteria. Add a sentence after each milestone's exit list: "Measured and published at exit, not gating: SM-14 (hypothesis)" (and SM-15 at M4). Alternatively, state in Sequencing that criteria tagged (hypothesis) are reported, not gating, and that a missed hypothesis opens an Open question in its owning document.

blocking.issue: R-6 cites the wrong source and understates the risk. In the runtime research, the fact that wazero has no fuel metering is sourced to issue #422. Issue #2466 reports that WithCloseOnContextDone, the deadline interruption R-6 offers as its first mitigation, slows loop-heavy guests 10–20x, and no fix had merged by 2026-09-12. SM-6 and PB-5 (M2 exit criterion 2) are measured with deadline interruption enabled, so this overhead directly threatens the M2 exit.
blocking.evidence: "| R-6 | wazero lacks fuel metering, so a CPU-bound Plugin holds a core ([source](https://github.com/wazero/wazero/issues/2466)) | Medium | High | Deadlines, call budgets, fault breakers (OQ-tech-stack-and-libraries-8); S4 variants gate M2 |". go-libraries-runtime.md: "Open issue #2466 (2026-01-11) reports a 10–20x slowdown on loop-heavy guests with it enabled... As of 2026-09-12 no fix has merged" and "No fuel or instruction metering... (https://github.com/wazero/wazero/issues/422)".
blocking.fix: Cite https://github.com/wazero/wazero/issues/422 for the missing fuel metering. Add a separate risk or a second clause citing https://github.com/wazero/wazero/issues/2466: "deadline interruption (`WithCloseOnContextDone`) costs 10–20x on loop-heavy guests, threatening SM-6 and PB-5 (M2 exit criterion 2)". Mitigation: host-side call budgets, the S4 loop-heavy variant as an M2 gate, and a fallback decision recorded in OQ-tech-stack-and-libraries-8.
